plan.summary:
Refresh now rejects malformed refresh tokens before calling the server. `maskToken` moves lower in `src/auth/tokens.ts`; the hunks show no change to its body.

- `refresh` throws `Malformed refresh token` unless the token matches `/^[\w-]{20,}$/`.
- `maskToken` is deleted at the top of the file and added again after `refresh`.
plan.riskRationale: Auth token handling changes. The new check can reject tokens that were accepted before. The diff shows no tests.
plan.storyArc: The main change is the new validation guard in `refresh`. The `maskToken` move is a separate, small supporting change.

noise.reason: This hunk only removes `maskToken` from the top of the file. The same function is added again in hunk-1.

topics.title: Reject malformed refresh tokens before the server call
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `refresh` do with a token that does not match the pattern? Check that the throw happens before `fetchTokens` and that the regex `^[\w-]{20,}$` is not stricter than real tokens. Also confirm that `maskToken` is only moved, with its body unchanged.
